milestones.description: Workspace.TycoonPlots contains at least one plot Model with an OwnerUserId IntValue and PurchaseButtons Folder.
milestones.check:
local folder = workspace:FindFirstChild("TycoonPlots")
if not folder or not folder:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "Workspace.TycoonPlots folder is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, plot in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
    if not plot:IsA("Model") then
        return false, "TycoonPlots contains a non-Model child"
    end
    local owner = plot:FindFirstChild("OwnerUserId")
    local buttons = plot:FindFirstChild("PurchaseButtons")
    if not owner or not owner:IsA("IntValue") then
        return false, "Plot needs OwnerUserId IntValue: " .. plot.Name
    end
    if not buttons or not buttons:IsA("Folder") then
        return false, "Plot needs PurchaseButtons Folder: " .. plot.Name
    end
    count = count + 1
end
if count == 0 then
    return false, "Need at least one tycoon plot"
end
return true, "Found " .. tostring(count) .. " structurally complete plot models"

milestones.description: ReplicatedStorage.TycoonRemotes.Purchase is a RemoteEvent, and ServerScriptService.PurchaseHandler has server OnServerEvent, OwnerUserId and Cash source signatures.
milestones.check:
local remotes = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("TycoonRemotes")
if not remotes or not remotes:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "TycoonRemotes folder is missing"
end
local remote = remotes:FindFirstChild("Purchase")
if not remote or not remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
    return false, "Purchase RemoteEvent is missing"
end
local handler = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("PurchaseHandler")
if not handler or not handler:IsA("Script") then
    return false, "Server PurchaseHandler Script is missing"
end
if not handler.Enabled or handler.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
    return false, "PurchaseHandler must run on the server"
end
local source = handler.Source
if not source:find("OnServerEvent:Connect", 1, true) then
    return false, "PurchaseHandler lacks OnServerEvent source signature"
end
if not source:find("OwnerUserId", 1, true) or not source:find("Cash", 1, true) then
    return false, "PurchaseHandler lacks owner and currency source signatures"
end
return true, "Purchase remote and server authority source signatures are present"

milestones.description: Every Buy-prefixed TextButton in StarterGui.TycoonGui has a PurchaseClient LocalScript that calls FireServer and has no direct Cash.Value assignment signature; at least one button exists.
milestones.check:
local gui = game:GetService("StarterGui"):FindFirstChild("TycoonGui")
if not gui or not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
    return false, "StarterGui.TycoonGui is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, button in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
    if button:IsA("TextButton") and button.Name:sub(1, 3) == "Buy" then
        local client = button:FindFirstChild("PurchaseClient")
        if not client or not client:IsA("LocalScript") then
            return false, "Buy button lacks PurchaseClient LocalScript: " .. button.Name
        end
        local source = client.Source
        if not source:find("FireServer(", 1, true) then
            return false, "Buy button does not call the server: " .. button.Name
        end
        if source:match("Cash%.Value%s*=") or source:match("leaderstats%.Cash%.Value%s*=") then
            return false, "Buy button source writes Cash.Value: " .. button.Name
        end
        count = count + 1
    end
end
if count == 0 then
    return false, "Need at least one Buy-prefixed TextButton"
end
return true, "Found " .. tostring(count) .. " server-calling buy buttons without direct Cash.Value assignments"

milestones.description: ServerStorage.TycoonUpgrades contains at least two Model assets held on the server rather than in a client GUI.
milestones.check:
local upgrades = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("TycoonUpgrades")
if not upgrades or not upgrades:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "ServerStorage.TycoonUpgrades folder is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, child in ipairs(upgrades:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        count = count + 1
    end
end
if count < 2 then
    return false, "Need two or more upgrade Model assets"
end
return true, "Found " .. tostring(count) .. " server-stored upgrade models"
